(Comedy drama) - 1960

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. programme.title: Life Without Dick
programme.desc: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2001

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck. (Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1977-06-17

programme.title: Hardwired
programme.desc: After surviving a car crash that kills his pregnant wife, Luke Gibson (Cuba Gooding Jr.) wakes up in the hospital with complete amnesia. He's been severely injured, but is alive thanks to a groundbreaking brain implant from a powerful multinational corporation. As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much. (Action, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009-11-03

programme.title: Half Past Dead
programme.desc: Criminal mastermind Donny/49er One (Morris Chestnut) has set in motion a plan to infiltrate a high-tech prison in order to persuade a death row inmate to reveal the whereabouts of $200 million worth of gold. Undercover FBI agent Sascha (Steven Seagal) must stop him before it's too late. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-11-15

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch. (Action, Movie, Science fiction) - 1998-05-19

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: After Neanderthal hunter Zed (Jack Black) is exiled for eating forbidden fruit, he and his sardonic buddy Oh (Michael Cera) leave their village and begin an epic journey through history. The pals encounter biblical characters such as Cain (David Cross) and Abel, Abraham (Hank Azaria), and others, and wind up in Sodom. Along the way, Zed debunks commonly held beliefs and replaces them with his own delusions of grandeur. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 2009-06-19

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2008-04-30

The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2011-02-18

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Thucydides On Strategy
programme.desc: A systematic look at what makes Thucydides perhaps history's first great strategist; his analysis of the Peloponnesian War; the political origins of the war; the Spartan and Athenian leadership; the social and moral implications of war. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Thucydides as a Possession for All Time
programme.desc: Joining a debate over the efficacy of the Sicilian Expedition; turning to the Melian Dialogue; the debate between realists and neoconservatives over the conduct of war; considering how this debate still plays out in contemporary America. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Sun Tzu's the Art of War
programme.desc: Sun Tzu's writing is popular in the modern world; the historical context for "Master Sun's Military Methods"; an overview of Sun Tzu's strategy for war, which is to be efficient, avoid protracted wars and value the commander's intellect and skill. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Sun Tzu Through Time
programme.desc: Charting Sun Tzu's historical importance throughout Chinese history, in feudal and modern Japan, and in the modern West; learning Sun Tzu's strategy of deception in action by exploring Operation Fortitude in the Allied invasion of Normandy. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Machiavelli's the Art of War
programme.desc: Learning about Machiavelli, the Italian Renaissance man who writes his own "The Art of War" in which he advocates a citizen-army; going through Machiavelli's book of tactics, which is his recommendation for Florentine military rulers. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Machiavelli's Discourses On Livy
programme.desc: Discovering fortuna, which is Machiavelli's philosophy of circumstances, and virtu, which is his recipe for military action; the strategies Machiavelli thinks a republican military should adopt; the qualities to look for in a good commander. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - The Napoleonic Revolution in War
programme.desc: Experiencing the battles of Jena and Auerstedt during the Napoleonic Wars; these two decisive victories demonstrate the radical transformation of warfare; they give rise to Antoine-Henri Jomini and Carl von Clausewitz, two important masters of war. (Educational, History) - 2012-09-28

programme.title: War in the Modern World - Afghanistan and the Nature of Modern War

programme.title: War in the Modern World - Nightmare Scenarios of Modern War
programme.desc: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

programme.title: War in the Modern World - The Tools of Modern Warfare
programme.desc: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

programme.title: War in the Modern World - From World War to Cold War

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
programme.desc: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present. (History) - 2022-07-15

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
programme.desc: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything. (History) - 2022-07-15

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Go: A Game of Near-Infinite Complexity
programme.desc: Go is an intricate strategy game that outshines chess in East Asia because of its challenging nature and unique setup. (History) - 2022-07-15

programme.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Sowing Seeds: Africa's Mancala Family

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Why Egypt Needed Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Understanding why Ancient Egypt has to invent some form of writing; central to this introduction is a study of the Narmer Palette; its writing sets standards and conventions that would be followed for 3,000 years. (World history) - 2016-10-21

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - The Ancient Egyptian Alphabet
programme.desc: Learning the hieroglyphic alphabet; how to write and position each hieroglyph, including a stylized hand, a horned viper and two hieroglyphs for which English does not have a letter; transcribing one's name from English to ancient Egyptian. (World history) - 2016-10-21

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - How a Language Becomes Lost

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Olivier Latry, der Titularorganist der großen Orgel der Pariser Kathedrale Notre-Dame, verzaubert mit einer meisterhaften Performance an der historischen Orgel der Kathedrale. Das Konzert entstand 2015 unter der Regie von Noëlle Louisor. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2019-05-07

programme.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 2, 'Auferstehung'
programme.desc: Orchester und Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino unter der Leitung von Myung-Whun Chung spielen Mahlers Auferstehungssymphonie. Solistinnen sind Christiane Karg, Sopran, und Claudia Huckle, Alt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-16

programme.title: Werke von Bach, Bartók und Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer führt sein Budapest Festival Orchester mit Werken von Johann Sebastian Bach, Béla Bartók und Johannes Brahms. Die Aufführung wurde am 4. Dezember 2017 in der Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2018-06-09

programme.title: Franck - Sonate für Violine und Klavier
programme.desc: Martha Argerich und Maxim Vengerov spielen César Francks Sonate für Violine und Klavier in A-Dur. Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin bei diesem Konzert im Château de Chantilly der Kammermusik. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-06-07

programme.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
programme.desc: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - II
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags erkundet die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich im Château de Chantilly das Repertoire der Kammermusik. Die "Grande Dame" des Klaviers wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-24

programme.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
programme.desc: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-12-03

programme.title: Beethoven, Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37
programme.desc: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique". (Special, Entertainment, Music, Classical) - 2017-03-27

programme.title: Werke für Cello und Klavier: Debussy, Brahms u.a
programme.desc: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein Konzert im Rahmen des Amiata Piano Festivals 2023, das im Forum Fondazione Bertarelli in Poggi del Sasso in Italien gegeben wurde. Es wurden Stücke von Claude Debussy und Johannes Brahms gespielt. (Special, Music, Event) - 2025-01-06

programme.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Beatrice Venezi führt an der Oper von Metz durch Giacomo Puccinis tragische Oper "Madama Butterfly". Die 1904 uraufgeführte Oper dreht sich um die junge japanische Geisha Butterfly, die auf die Rückkehr ihres amerikanischen Geliebten wartet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-09-26

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation des technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade Nr. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93

programme.title: Streichquartett Nr. 7 & 13 und Große Fuge

programme.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: S1 E5 Childhood Flavors Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: S1 E6 My Life As A Cook - New York City Experience the formative moments of Tony's career as he revisits his first job and the culinary institute that taught him the basics.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: S8 E80 Powered Powders Adam is joined by cook Lilly Wright and comedian Sashi Perera to unleash the power of spice powders.

programme.title: Jamie At Home
programme.desc: S2 E11 Winter Salad Jamie has been invited on a local shoot and uses the opportunity to explore the world of delicious game birds.

programme.title: Cheese Slices

programme.title: What Chefs Want

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.desc: S2 E10 Ali & Mitch Torres: Barni (Goanna) Caesar Salad & PAN Fried Damper Ali and Mitch take the bush goanna and give it a dressing up in this recipe of the traditional Caesar Salad, replacing the chicken and eggs with chunky pieces of Barni and served with damper.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: S1 E9 Pizzas Not many of us are lucky enough to have a wood oven in the back yard. But all is not lost. If you want to make brilliant home cooked pizzas, all you need is a conventional oven.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: S8 E23 Episode 23 In the heart of the beautiful McLaren Vale, Laura is joined by her chef husband, Max, to whip up a simple but awesome Italian dish, Spaghetti Aglio Olio E Pepperoncino.

programme.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programme.desc: S1 E23 Truffle Eggs With Chips And Chives Living in Tuscany allows for the enjoyment of a long truffle season, Rachael shows how to use local truffles to add amazing flavour to a fun and decadent dish of scrambled eggs and potato chips.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: S8 E5 More North West Tasmania Still in Tasmania's north west, Hayden hunts down the ultimate ingredients for his dream dessert-cooked on a BBQ. From windswept shores to artisan kitchens, this is Tasmania at its most delicious.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programme.desc: S6 E1 Eric Ripert The incredible chef and world class restaurateur behind the three Michelin star Le Bernardin restaurant in New York, Eric Ripert, is cooking at the barn and sharing life-changing stories.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: S9 E18 Episode 18 Laura is joined by Sweet Greek's Kathy Tsaples to make amygdalota, Greek almond-based cookies; Asian Inspirations' chef Kinsan makes S&B curry noodles; Laura makes her cheat's ramen.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: S8 E80 Powered Powders Adam is joined by cook Lilly Wright and comedian Sashi Perera to unleash the power of spice powders.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
